findings.text: the helper was renamed from _record_path to record_path, but three production callers still call the old name and now raise AttributeError: reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:1035, reckon/crew/recovery_repair_dispatch.py:93, :134 and :137. _promoted_awaiting_merge sits on the settled-run classification path (reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:2829) and catches only OSError and ValueError, so every classification of a settled run now raises instead of returning its awaiting-merge verdict. Reproduced against an extraction of the head revision: recovery_classification._promoted_awaiting_merge({'run_id': 'r-x'}, moment=0.0) raises AttributeError: module 'reckon.crew.pending_landing' has no attribute '_record_path'. This is the module the landing pass reads, so the change breaks the reader of the very state it protects.

five test files still reference pending_landing._record_path and will red at the head: tests/test_a_finished_pending_landing_retires_its_run.py (63,87,105,125,132,181,198,230,247,283), tests/test_a_discarded_run_stays_discarded.py (67,73,141,163,184,262), tests/test_a_landed_reading_follows_the_primary_branch.py (134,188), tests/test_a_promoted_run_is_not_landed_until_merged.py (119,122) and tests/test_a_conflicting_landing_is_repaired.py (246). The node's after arm names only its own new test and tests/test_staged_write_inventory.py, so this is invisible to its recorded gate and would surface as added failures in a full-suite run. Fixed by the same repair as the blocking finding.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit 92b44849 against fb92136a: four files, 145 insertions and 5 deletions; the crew_run_commands.py hunk adds the pre-write refusal at :3653-3666 and moves an existing import, pending_landing.py adds the empty-project guard at :88 and renames :60 to record_path, and the test file and the fragment are new.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when's three assertions are exactly tests/test_a_landing_without_*_pending_record.py:93 (exit_code != 0), :94 (the record's bytes are unchanged) and :95-99 (finish_pending_landings returns one row naming the run with the cited head), plus the second test at :104 asserting no file is written for an empty project; after-arm.log records 54 passed EXIT=0 over both files and negative-control.log at fb92136a records 3 failed EXIT=1 whose first failure is line 98 'the pending record was overwritten', matching the declared mutation.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to keep a pending-landing record when its run's pointer is gone so the landing pass can still finish it; reckon/crew_run_commands.py:3653 resolves the existing record's path in a refusal that raises before any write, and reckon/crew/pending_landing.py:88 returns early from write_pending when the project is empty or whitespace, so a record naming a project survives and finish_pending_landings(only_run=...) still yields its row.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, one commit 92b44849, arms recorded as base 51 passed and head 54 passed with the negative control red at 3 failed, and its rubric lines claim all six dimensions answered.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared paths are reckon/crew/pending_landing.py, reckon/crew_run_commands.py, tests/test_a_landing_without_its_pointer_keeps_the_pending_record.py, the evidence fragment at docs/evidence/fragments/concurrent-edits-meet-at-the-merge/a-landing-without-its-pointer-keeps-the-pending-record.html and an unused figures directory; the diff touches the first four and every one is inside the fence, but the rename inside pending_landing.py changes behaviour its out-of-fence callers depend on.

justifications.durability: each guard reddens on its own reinstatement (negative-control.log fails the byte comparison at tests/test_a_landing_without_its_pointer_keeps_the_pending_record.py:94 and the no-write cases), but no assertion covers the renamed helper's callers and the node's arms never run the five test files that reference it.
justifications.evidence: after-arm.log and base-arm.log on disk carry revision headers, module paths, commands and EXIT lines, and negative-control.log reds at tests/test_a_landing_without_its_pointer_keeps_the_pending_record.py:98 exactly as the node declared.
justifications.fit: the added guard and refusal follow the surrounding style of reckon/crew/pending_landing.py:88, but exposing a private helper as public without updating reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:1035 is not the pattern its callers observe.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/pending_landing.py:88 and reckon/crew_run_commands.py:3653 implement the plan's deliverable exactly, refusing before any write and keeping a named record intact.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew_run_commands.py:3653 reuses pending_landing.record_path rather than recomputing the directory, and a search of reckon/crew for another pending-record path helper found none.
justifications.scope_discipline: reckon/crew/pending_landing.py:60 changes a name three out-of-fence production modules call, so the diff's reach exceeds its declared write paths although every changed path is listed.
